approval_case.title: Update one pull-request record when its decision changes
approval_case.situation: Pull request 418 already has one open review record, but def456 replaces a deprecated encryption dependency with an approved platform library used by other services. All checks pass, and repository policy requires Hao to approve this dependency change.
approval_case.hao_request: A new run proposes another generic review message.
approval_case.correct_behavior: Update the existing pull-request record instead of creating a duplicate. Deliver one material-change update that names PR 418 at head def456, the approved platform replacement, and the passing checks. Recommend approving that exact PR/head artifact. Use direct replies: `approve PR 418@def456` lets the owner merge the PR only while its head remains def456; `reject PR 418@def456` returns it for revision. May verifies the post-merge checks or follows the revision.
